payload.summary: ask-matt (mattpocock/skills, skills/engineering/ask-matt) is a ROUTER skill, not a Q&A bot: SKILL.md with disable-model-invocation:true, a hierarchical decision map organized by STARTING SITUATION (main idea->ship flow, on-ramps like bugs/foggy-projects that merge onto it, codebase-health, vocabulary layer, standalone), each entry described by its ENTRY CONDITION (the problem state) not its name, terminating in one specific skill. Explicit maintenance rule: whenever a skill is added/renamed/removed or its fit changes, ask-matt's map is updated in the same change. It links deeper reference docs rather than inlining. Sources: github.com/mattpocock/skills README + skills/engineering/ask-matt/SKILL.md.
